content: अभ्यनुज्ञा €9 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To permit, assent or agree to, approve; अतोऽभ्यनुजानातु भवती <ls>K. 209</ls>; <ls>M. 3</ls>; .²2 To permit one to go, grant leave to, dismiss. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To ask for leave, to depart, take leave.

अभ्यनुज्ञा, -ज्ञानम् .²1 Consent, approval, permission. कृताभ्यनुज्ञा गुरुणा गरीयसा <ls>Ku. 5. 7</ls>, <ls>R. 2. 69</ls>. .²2 Order, command. .²3 Granting leave of absence, dismissing. .²4 Admission of an argument.
